use_when: 智能体框架
AI Agent
Function组件
应用+智能体
如何使用Function组件拉起小艺开放平台上线的智能体
如何在应用中集成AI智能体入口实现应用+智能体组合服务
如何将智能客服、智能助手、内容生成等AI能力嵌入到应用界面中
如何在小艺开放平台创建和配置智能体后绑定到应用Function组件
如何通过Function组件传递参数与智能体进行自然语言交互
当开发者需要将AI智能体能力集成到应用中时，应使用Agent Framework Kit
如果你已经在小艺开放平台上线了智能体，并希望用户能够在应用内直接与智能体交互，Agent Framework Kit提供了Function组件作为标准化的智能体入口
适用于需要为应用添加AI对话、智能客服、智能助手、内容生成等AI增强功能的场景
如果你的应用需要根据用户当前的操作上下文，在合适的时机引导用户使用智能体服务，Agent Framework Kit提供了灵活的组件集成方案
在应用页面嵌入 AI 对话入口并拉起已发布的智能体 / Embed an AI chat entry in the app and launch a published agent
接入 Function 组件让用户在应用内直接调用小艺智能体服务 / Integrate the Function component so users can invoke Xiaoyi agent services inside the app
把智能客服助手集成到订单页或服务页 / Add an AI customer service assistant to the order page or service page
根据当前页面上下文向智能体传参并发起对话 / Pass current page context to the agent and start a conversation
在应用中展示内容生成、问答或推荐类智能体能力 / Show content generation, Q&A, or recommendation agent capabilities in the app
绑定小艺开放平台已配置的智能体到应用功能入口 / Bind an agent configured on the Xiaoyi Open Platform to an app function entry
实现应用内的 AI 助手面板用于咨询、生成和任务指引 / Build an in-app AI assistant panel for help, generation, and task guidance
在合适的操作时机引导用户使用智能体服务 / Guide users to agent services at the right moment in a workflow
给现有业务页面增加一个可交互的智能体卡片或入口按钮 / Add an interactive agent card or entry button to an existing business page
让应用和智能体组合提供连续服务体验 / Combine the app and agent to deliver a continuous service experience
通过 Function 组件拉起与业务场景相关的 AI 助理 / Launch a scenario-specific AI assistant through the Function component
在应用里接入自然语言交互能力处理咨询和操作指引 / Add natural language interaction in the app for support and action guidance
do_not_use_when: 需求是做OCR文字识别、人脸检测比对、主体分割、多目标识别或17点骨骼人体姿态分析，应改用 core-vision-kit / The task is OCR, face detection and comparison, subject segmentation, multi-object recognition, or 17-point human pose analysis; use core-vision-kit instead

需求是离线语音转文字、长短音频识别，或多音色中英文文本转语音朗读，应改用 core-speech-kit / The requirement is offline speech-to-text for short or long audio, or multi-voice Chinese and English text-to-speech playback; use core-speech-kit instead

需求是做人脸活体检测、卡证OCR、文档扫描自动裁剪，或识图搜索等视觉处理，应改用 vision-kit / The job is face liveness detection, card/document OCR, document scan auto-cropping, or image search style visual processing; use vision-kit instead

需求是对中英文文本做分词、实体抽取，识别日期、地址、电话号码或电子邮件等命名实体，应改用 natural-language-kit / The task is Chinese or English tokenization and entity extraction, including named entities such as dates, addresses, phone numbers, or email addresses; use natural-language-kit instead
preconditions: 目标智能体已在小艺开放平台创建、配置并成功上线 / The target agent has been created, configured, and successfully published on the Xiaoyi Open Platform
工程已集成Agent Framework Kit并具备可使用Function组件的HarmonyOS API环境 / The project has integrated Agent Framework Kit and has a HarmonyOS API environment that supports the Function component
应用具备拉起小艺开放平台智能体所需的标识与绑定配置 / The app has the required identifiers and binding configuration for launching the Xiaoyi Open Platform agent
inputs: 智能体标识或绑定配置 / agent identifier or binding configuration
Function组件配置参数 / Function component configuration parameters
传递给智能体的上下文参数 / context parameters passed to the agent
承载入口的页面或界面位置 / page or UI location hosting the entry

postconditions.statement: 已在应用界面中添加并配置可用的Function组件入口 / A usable Function component entry has been added and configured in the app UI
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show that a Function component from Agent Framework Kit was added or configured in a UI/page file to serve as an agent entry?

postconditions.statement: Function组件已绑定到指定的已上线智能体 / The Function component has been bound to the specified published agent
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include explicit binding or identification of the target published agent in the Function component configuration?

postconditions.statement: 如有业务需要，已配置向智能体传递启动上下文或参数 / If required by the business flow, launch context or parameters are configured to be passed to the agent
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task mentions passing context, do the edits show parameters or contextual data being wired into the Function component or agent launch configuration?
